title: A returning wheelchair user opens a new home
about: Maya has used Cranley once before, on another house. This is her second visit.

steps.say: Maya uses a wheelchair. Last time she told Cranley her chair's width, removed one tool and waved off one kind of check. Cranley kept that.

steps.label: Cranley knows
steps.say: What it knows about her. Every line says where it came from, and she can change or forget it.

steps.text: Is this one workable for me?
steps.say: A different house, and six words. She does not repeat her chair width, and Cranley does not ask.

else.say: Offline: the doorway check alone, run with the chair width Cranley already has.

steps.say: What it did because of her: used her chair width, skipped the question, left out the tool she removed, kept back the checks she waved off.

steps.label: Checks
steps.say: The kinds of check she marked useful last time are listed first.

steps.label: Not relevant: Grab bars
steps.say: She fits her own rails. One click hides that kind of check, here and in every later investigation.

steps.label: Undo
steps.say: And one click takes it back.

steps.label: Cranley knows
steps.say: Counted from her own history, not written by a model: what each visit asked, reused and kept back.
